reviews.title: My favorite App
reviews.text:
I truly can’t say enough good things about Kndrd. I’ve been using it since moving to NYC and it has been the best way I’ve made friends here. Moving to a new city can make meeting people feel really difficult and like everyone else already has big groups of friends, but Kndrd makes it so much easier to actually find girls you have things in common with.

There’s something really special about the people on Kndrd and the community that has grown around it. I recommend it to literally every girl I know in NYC. If you’re new here, want to meet more people, or just want to expand your circle, you need Kndrd.

reviews.title: Be aware of charges
reviews.text: I’ve had several times been charged extra without consent or locked out saying I haven’t paid when I have. I believe the team is trying their best to make this app the best. However, the lack of due diligence has caused several unauthorized charges. Additionally, several people of this app aren’t intentional on wanting to be friends. You’re better off using bumble bff or Facebook/instagram groups that are free.

reviews.title: Have to wait an indefinite amount of time to get approved, FALSE ADVERTISING
reviews.text: I saw so many good things about this app and was super excited to try it. I downloaded it and spent time making up my profile only to be told that my application is under review. At first I thought maybe they’re just trying to make sure it’s real people signing up but after seeing I was over 10,000th in line and I could “move up” by inviting friends, I knew something was fishy. After reading other reviews my suspicions were confirmed that they are just nitpicking who they approved. Like seriously, is this highschool?? And why on earth would I invite friends? So they can waste their time and not be approved either?
